items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of hunting licence
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Bescheid dated Thursday 19.11.2026, sent by simple letter. Per the letter's own clause (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG), deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting: 19.11. + 4 days = 23.11.2026 (Monday) – a normal business day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies to the fiction itself. The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, since the triggering event is the Bekanntgabe on 23.11.2026) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day: 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift under § 193 BGB is needed.

items.title: Submit valid hunting liability insurance confirmation to get licence issued
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: The letter gives no calendar date or period for submitting the renewed insurance confirmation; it only states the licence will be issued once it is received ('sobald'). No deadline can be computed from this wording, though doing so is a precondition for obtaining the licence at all.
